d.t: WATER ATTENUATING PLANTING TRAY MODULES FOR EXTENSIVE GREEN ROOFS
d.s: SikaRoof VersiDrain BG is a lightweight planting tray designed for extensive blue green roofs and functions as a water retaining tray, water attenuation tray, and a drainage mat. Modules are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and consist of three layers: a planting layer, an irrigation reservoir area, and a stormwater attenuation layer. SikaRoof VersiDrain BG interlock with adjacent modules for easy installation and has a smooth base for safe placement directly over the waterproofing membrane. Its internal irrigation reservoir promotes plant sustainability and its stormwater attenuation layer collects and slowly releases at-source stormwater to mititgate overburdening of drainage infrastructures amidst our current crisis.
a: Trays interlock adjacently for uniform coverage
Smooth base protects underlying waterproofing membrane
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Water retention, attenuation and drainage layer for extensive blue green roofs, landscape decks and lightweight green installations requiring water storage in combination with a suitable geotextile as a filtration layer to prevent planting media from clogging the reservoir and drainage layer.

sec.t: Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No. SGBP 3260
No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance with the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet

Bundles must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements
Water Reservoir Capacity | Water Retention Capacity 10 L/m2 | 40 L/m2

Clean and sound surface shall have at least a wood float finish. All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure. High spots in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be cut off or ground down to prevent damage/puncture to the water retention planting tray module.

SikaRoof VersiDrain BG shall be loosely laid and interlocked with adjacent modules connected by proprietary clips to form a continuous water retention and drainage layer without any mechanical fixing either on top of the waterproofing membrane or on top of the concrete surface. The installed water retention and drainage modules would then be covered with an approved or Sika geotextile filter fabric before pouring the planting media into the modules.
